column1: # Seed corpus. One utterance per line, tab separated.
# WHAT THIS IS NOT. PRD section 7 calls for two hundred utterances recorded by
# the author speaking. This is not that. Every line below was typed, by the
# person who also wrote the grammar, in the shape M0 is known to emit. It
# proves the grammar reads the sentences its author imagined. It proves
# nothing at all about whether real speech arrives in that shape, because no
# speech was involved. The recorded corpus is a separate, unstarted, shipping
# deliverable and this file is not a substitute for it.
# The clock for every row is Saturday 12 September 2026, 11:30, Europe/Zurich.
# Columns:
#   1 utterance, in M0 output shape: lowercase, unpunctuated, numbers as words
#   2 intent:    event | note | agenda | availability | unparsed
#   3 text:      expected title or note body, or - where the intent has none
#   4 start:     expected local start, ISO, or - where none is expected
#   5 minutes:   expected duration in minutes, or - where none is expected
#   6 allday:    y or n, or - where it does not apply
